facts.fact: The temple is on Manuel López Cotilla in Colonia Americana.
Its original architectural project is Neo-Gothic, by Italian architect Adamo Boari.
Construction began in1897 and was interrupted during the early20thcentury.
Ignacio Díaz Morales assumed direction in1927 and redesigned the interior in French Gothic style.
